answer: Anchor every agent identity to a single non-transferable relic: a hardware attestation bound to one device, issued once per machine and impossible to clone. Reputation then grows like timber, adding one verifiable ring per season of honest work, so a fresh identity carries almost no weight. Peers mirror each other's attestations in a public log, so a claim seen by only one witness is ignored. Forging a thousand sybils would need a thousand real devices and years of patient history, far more than any single attack could earn back.
